project_title: USP India Heritage Portfolio - Responsive Blueprint & Desktop-Only Editor Guidelines

persona_and_strategy.design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Growth, Calm - Heritage & Conservation)
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Combine architectural heritage precision, editorial typography, and warm tactile textures.
Emotion First: Evoke deep reverence for historical preservation, craft, and architectural restoration.
Content is King: Narrative-driven section flow with preserved absolute visual integrity.
Preserve Live Geometry: Ensure user-edited text sizes, accent lines, and section positioning remain intact on desktop while seamlessly scaling/stacking on mobile/tablet.

editor_scope.mobile_tablet_behavior: Disable LiveEditor controls, floating panel, selection overlays, drag/resize handles, and selection outlines below 1024px width. Render clean public view only or display a clear desktop-only notice bar when logged in as admin on mobile/tablet.

breakpoint_strategy.mobile_sm: 320px - 639px (Single-column linear stack, auto section heights, responsive text scaling, padded margins)
breakpoint_strategy.tablet_md: 640px - 1023px (Two-column adaptative layouts, scaled imagery, static interactive elements)
breakpoint_strategy.desktop_lg: 1024px - 1439px (Full heritage grid, active LiveEditor when logged in, relative/absolute stored geometry application)
breakpoint_strategy.desktop_xl: 1440px+ (Max-width boxed layout container centering, full LiveEditor capabilities)

layout_risks_and_mitigations.risk: Stored absolute heights and transforms (_section height720, translateY-96) cause overlaps or empty gaps on smaller screens.
layout_risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Override fixed pixel height with min-height on screens < 1024px. Convert 3-column/2-column split into stacked flex/grid layout on mobile with standard 40px/48px vertical padding.

layout_risks_and_mitigations.risk: Overlapping grid cell with negative translateY (-343px / 82.8px) causing image truncation on narrow viewports.
layout_risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Disable negative vertical translation on screens < 768px; switch to natural flow flex-column with image following text.

layout_risks_and_mitigations.risk: Dense horizontal desktop link array overflowing small screens or obscuring hero content.
layout_risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Use fixed glassmorphism header backdrop (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 or bg-stone-900/80 - NEVER pure transparent). Provide responsive slide-out or collapsible mobile menu below 768px.

layout_risks_and_mitigations.component: Field Note Article Modal & Hero Accent Lines
layout_risks_and_mitigations.risk: Fixed 42px accent lines and relative position offsets shifting outside readable viewport bounds on mobile.
layout_risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Keep accent lines inline with flex containers, use overflow-x-hidden on article modal wrapper, and constrain modal max-width to 92vw on mobile.

contrast_rules: No complete transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, or overlays.
Header & Floating Nav must use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl and non-zero background opacity (e.g. bg-white/80 or bg-stone-900/80).
Interactive focus and hover states must guarantee minimum APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 text contrast.

typography.font_family_heading: Serif / Display Heritage Font (Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond)
typography.font_family_body: Clean Sans / Mono (IBM Plex Sans / Work Sans / System Sans)

component_guidelines.shadcn_and_tailwind_usage: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for public portfolio page structures. Reserve customized Shadcn primitives for dialogs, modals, and input fields.
component_guidelines.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive and key informational elements (buttons, links, inputs, cards, headers, section containers, field note items, contact fields) MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes (kebab-case).

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT alter stored database geometries or desktop rendering values.
Ensure LiveEditor features (drag handles, selection toolbar, inspector panel) are rendered ONLY when window width >= 1024px.
On mobile/tablet (< 1024px), suppress editor controls entirely or display a desktop-only editing notification bar.
Apply responsive CSS overrides via media queries (md:, lg:) to prevent section height clipping, text overlaps, and image cutoffs.
Keep header background non-transparent across all pages to ensure legibility over page content and hero images.
Preserve all data-testid attributes across existing components.
